_readme: The near-miss detector's evaluation matrix, COMMITTED so its numbers are reproducible.
Three rounds of review changed this pattern, each justified by a matrix that lived
only in the author's scratchpad. Round 4 built a different 20-shape matrix and got
the opposite verdict from round 3's 8-shape one — because a matrix nobody can re-run
is an opinion. `test_subsystem_touch.py` reads this file, so changing the pattern
means changing numbers anyone can reproduce.
